name: Avenge My Village
label: Quest
description: Makaba Flathoof asks Horde travelers to answer the Grimtotem assault on his village in southeastern Stonetalon. He barely survived, cut off from his kin…

clips.title: The story
paras: Makaba Flathoof asks Horde travelers to answer the Grimtotem assault on his village in southeastern Stonetalon. He barely survived, cut off from his kin and surrounded by the dead, and now seeks vengeance at the ruffians’ and hired sellswords’ encampment.

Near the Barrens border, Makaba Flathoof is the lone survivor of a massacre in the red stone passes of Stonetalon. Grimtotem raiders descended without warning and slaughtered nearly everyone in his settlement. Makaba fought back and brought down several attackers, but they drove him into hiding with little more than his life and his wrath.

The Grimtotem have long troubled the tauren tribes united under High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Unlike the peaceful nomads of Mulgore, their warbands use ruthless ruffians and opportunistic mercenaries to seize territory and strike isolated settlements. Makaba has no thought of diplomacy or tribal kinship now. Only blood repaid with blood can answer his grief.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Grimtotem Clan raided my village and killed most everyone. I killed all I could, but barely escaped with my life.
Friend, all I wish now is that more of them are dead. You will find them just to the west of here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, I thank you... But I will never forget what the Grimtotem have done to my village.
